name: Transcendent Lineage
body:
Your divine marker is more potent than even other god-blooded.

Prerequisites: God-blooded, god-blooded divine surge racial trait.

Benefit: Once per day, you regain divine surge if you fail the roll to which it was added.

Special: You can take this feat twice. The second time, you can reroll a natural 1 on your divine surge die any number of times before determining the results of your roll.
